benchmark_method: Five sequential runs per binary per workload, alternating order; normal clocks; posix_spawn and per-child wait4; warm filesystem caches, no explicit warmup; raw outputs compared on every pair.
phase: Fifth pass: repeated dataflow/lifetime/algorithm scans; BED, all LD readers, VCF record memory and Perl
baseline_scope: C++ regression against original commit, matching build configurations. Incremental performance against previous fourth-pass delivery. Perl production files were unchanged before this pass.

normal.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

lapack.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

ld_reader_probe.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
ld_reader_probe.contract: Exact CHROM, POS, allele count, genotype order and values, final rdstate/gcount/position and remaining raw bytes on binary ifstreams.
limitations: Not a CLI regression or performance benchmark.
Headers are complete; malformed header behavior is unchanged and not tested.
Packed rows with zero available genotype bytes and nonzero samples are excluded because the baseline reads an uninitialized char.
Default stream exception mask; arbitrary OS I/O errors and exception-enabled streams are not modeled.

bed_model.scope: Independent algorithm model only, not a substitute for binary byte comparisons. Queries cover the legacy invariant start <= end. BED parsing, header skipping, raw entry logging, chromosome-map lifetime and allele-span arithmetic are unchanged.

entry_reset_probe.scope: Actual linked VCF/BCF entry objects; public filtering, parsing, getters and VCF rendering. Initial/empty reset states, owned bytes after caller mutation, interleaved records, NUL, CRLF, truncation and long-to-short rows.
limitations: Not a whole CLI regression or performance benchmark.
Explicit object directories must match their supplied source headers.
BCF fixture bytes use the native integer layout expected by this implementation.

scratch_comparison.method: Sorted complete raw-byte multisets, ignoring random private filenames only. Public files and diagnostics use unchanged byte comparisons.

workloads.name: bed-disjoint
workloads.description: 40000 disjoint intervals and 20000 unsorted query sites, mixed hits/misses.

workloads.name: bed-disjoint-exclude
workloads.description: 40000 disjoint intervals and 20000 unsorted query sites, mixed hits/misses.

workloads.name: bed-nested-long-row
workloads.description: Large BED is loaded before an 8-MiB VCF row, exposing retained interval and row buffers.

workloads.name: bed-nested-misses
workloads.description: 300000 nested intervals coalesce to one; 3000 queries outside every interval.

workloads.name: ld-chisq-six-alleles-128
workloads.description: 1000 six-allele sites / 128 samples, 24-site window; two-byte genotypes and 21-by-21 contingency tables, under 24000 result rows.

workloads.name: ld-genotype-128
workloads.description: 2400 sites / 128 samples, 48-site standard genotype window; threshold limits output after calculation.

workloads.name: ld-genotype-65536
workloads.description: 12 sites / 65536 samples; large-cohort control for decoded-vector RAM versus fixed reader overhead.

workloads.name: ld-haplotype-1024
workloads.description: 500 phased sites / 1024 samples, 24-site standard haplotype window; includes perfect linked pairs.

workloads.name: ld-interchromosomal-128
workloads.description: 720 sites / 128 samples on three chromosomes; exercises accepted cross-chromosome pairs and skipped same-chromosome payloads.

workloads.name: ld-selected-haplotype-1024
workloads.description: 60 selected sites versus 660 other sites / 1024 samples, three chromosomes, narrow 120-bp window; exposes decoding before chromosome/distance gates.

workloads.name: vcf-long-info-kept
workloads.description: An 8-MiB INFO record isolates full-row retention when genotype parsing is unnecessary.

workloads.name: vcf-wide-samples
workloads.description: 4096 samples, three approximately 8-MiB records with unused FORMAT data and active genotype filters.

case.name: indel-long-repeat
case.description: 400 classifications of 20 kb repeat alleles, insertion and deletion

case.name: annotate-long-repeat
case.description: Real annotate CLI with 400 long repeat insertions

case.name: validator-unique-early
case.description: 900 diagnostics, 300 distinct groups, third mismatch near start

case.name: phase-overlap
case.description: Real flush_buffer/output_line/report_stats functions, 2,000 samples x 300 overlap sites

case.name: indel-short-control
case.description: 300,000 short insertion, deletion, and complex-event pairs

case.name: indel-nonrepeat-control
case.description: 4,000 kilobase complex pairs; early/late mismatches without long repeated suffixes

rejected_to_tab_experiment.decision: Reverted cache; modest dense benefit did not justify sparse regressions and retained memory. Final to-tab is byte-identical source to phase4.

case.name: tab-dense
case.description: 2,000 samples x 1,000 variants; unsorted header names

case.name: tab-sparse
case.description: 2,000 header samples, approximately 1% populated; legacy empty-column warnings retained

case.name: tab-dense-then-sparse
case.description: Complete first row followed by sparse rows; cached-key absence checks

case.name: tab-duplicate-header
case.description: 2,000 header columns with 400 distinct names; per-record fallback

perl_control_metadata.measurement: posix_spawnp/wait4; each child peak RSS; fixture preparation excluded

limitations: Finite same-platform test corpus, not a proof for all inputs, toolchains or architectures. Baseline undefined behavior is not repaired by performance changes.
C++ CLI raw diagnostics and RNG use fixed clock; performance uses real clocks and retains elapsed-time diagnostic differences separately.

Perl comparisons keep original bytes and physical script paths. Clock/hash settings are controlled; pre-existing nondeterministic hash ordering and ASLR addresses are inconclusive, not byte-equivalence passes.

phased-join and validator grouping probes exercise actual loaded subroutines. No full indexed phased-join CLI integration without tabix; annotate, stats, validator and to-tab CLI cases are separately covered.

BED parsing, first-line skipping, EOF-inclusive log counts, longest-allele spans and shared chromosome-map lifecycle remain unchanged. Existing unsafe mixed positions/BED initialization is not repaired.
LD storage halves two genotype buffers on int32/short16 platforms, with an added fixed 4KiB read stack buffer. Small-process peak RSS may increase; all measured increments are retained.
VCF copy removal eliminates a whole-row retained vector; parser/string stream ownership remains unchanged. BCF keeps its original raw vector.
Original PCA ragged matrices on unfiltered negative genotype sums, hapcount use-after-free and TsTv-quality out-of-range paths remain separate baseline issues.
No extra all-site LD cache, floating-point reassociation, threshold/window change or output normalization was introduced.
